items.summary: Developing core algorithms and software pipelines for advanced industrial manufacturing applications (Wire Arc Additive Manufacturing – WAAM).
highlights: Design and implement computational geometry and algorithmic control pipelines for robotic metal 3D printing (WAAM).
Develop high-performance toolpath generation, slicing, and kinematic planning algorithms.
Bridge advanced computational engineering, software development, and industrial manufacturing automation.

items.company: Commonwealth Scientific and Industrial Research Organisation (CSIRO)
items.summary: Designed and built solutions for population-scale health and biosecurity problems with the Transformational Bioinformatics Group.
highlights: Architected and built cloud-native distributed platforms and pipelines handling population-scale genomics and infectious disease biosecurity data.
Designed scalable genomic search and data exchange protocols including GA4GH Beacon standards (sBeacon, AskBeacon).
Led DevOps, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), and cloud infrastructure architecture across distributed teams.
Awarded CSIRO Entrepreneurship Award 2024 (Indonesia biosecurity platform) and CSIRO Science & Engineering Award 2022 (SARS-CoV-2 monitoring capability).
